from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    bycolor={}
    for r,c in cells: bycolor.setdefault(g[r][c],[]).append((r,c))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for col,pts in bycolor.items():
        if len(pts)<2: continue
        # direction: mode of (dr,dc) between consecutive cells
        from itertools import combinations
        dirs=Counter((b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]) for a,b in combinations(pts,2))
        dr,dc=dirs.most_common(1)[0][0]
        s=sorted(pts)
        # extend from the end that continues the direction
        ends=[min(s),max(s)]
        for end in ends:
            r,c=end[0]+dr,end[1]+dc
            while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
                if out[r][c]!=bg: break
                out[r][c]=col; r+=dr; c+=dc
    return out

import os,re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
i2=G['Demo pair 2 input']; o2=G['Demo pair 2 output']
def cells(g):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return {(r,c):v for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) for v in [g[r][c]] if v!=bg}, bg
ci,bg=cells(i2); co,_=cells(o2)
print('bg',bg)
print('in :',{k:v for k,v in sorted(ci.items())})
print('out:',{k:v for k,v in sorted(co.items())})
print('added:',{k:v for k,v in sorted(set(co.items())-set(ci.items()))})
print('removed:',sorted(set(ci.items())-set(co.items())))
